# Ashgrove Kennels prices, 2027

- A small dog is £18 a night. A large dog is £24 a night.
- Count the nights a dog sleeps at the kennels. A dog that arrives on Friday and leaves on Monday sleeps three nights: Friday, Saturday and Sunday.
- Easter weekend supplement: £6 per dog for each night from Friday 26 March to Sunday 28 March.
- Each owner gets one bill with one total for all their dogs.
